messages:
liz: Heads-up: draft release notes & internal announce ready for tomorrow's microrelease. Need pin, quiet window, and a short rollback rehearsal sign-off by EOD.

michael: checking doc now. Proposal: pin runtime to v2.11.4 for canary and full rollout if green.

tara: +1 for pin. That build contains the kv-cache patch we tested.

samir: agree on v2.11.4. Also note model fallback mapping updated; include in RN.

ops-oncall: Ops asks explicit rollback triggers: p95 latency > 1.8x baseline OR error rate > 1.0% sustained for 3m. Caller: ops-oncall; comms in #incidents.

liz: added those triggers and the exact rollback steps in RN. Rollback command: `rb rollback --tag=rel-20240215 --immediate` and abort pre-canary: `rb cancel --tag=rel-20240215`.

deploybot: Scheduled deployment created by @liz for 2024-02-15 22:30 UTC. Canary: 15% (region: us-west1). Command: `rb deploy --env=prod --tag=rel-20240215 --canary=15`.

michael: small telemetry change is included (token-level logs). Finance heads-up please: "expect a small, transient shift in token counts for ~24h".

tara: wording suggestion for internal blurb: "small transient token-count variance". Less scary.

liz: updated wording to Tara's suggestion and added a one-line note for PMs to prepare external comms if needed.

samir: added a canary checklist to RN: healthcheck endpoints, synthetic p95 probe, token-rate sanity check, KV hit-rate monitor, and fallback exercise. Included the curl snippets.

ops-oncall: propose a quick rollback rehearsal at 22:40 (10 min after canary start): simulate degradations for 2m and run the rollback path. If rehearsal fails, we keep canary at 15% and investigate before ramp.

michael: approve rehearsal plan. Will watch p95 and error-rate panels.

liz: scheduled rehearsal note in RN and added owners for each step (who flips the toggle, who runs rollback, who posts comms).

ops-oncall: quiet window requested 22:00-00:00 UTC. I'll be oncall and will post status updates here during rollout.

deploybot: Reminder: to abort before canary run `rb cancel --tag=rel-20240215`

liz: plan: post internal announce at 17:30 so PMs/product have time to prep external messaging. Doc link: https://redwood.example/docs/rn/2024-02-15-microrelease-internal (internal).

michael: Approved. Small grammar nit in the customer-facing blurb, fixed.

tara: Approved. Added a one-paragraph customer comms snippet to RN in case we need to explain a rollback.

samir: Approved. I'll be on alert for KV cache regressions and token anomalies. Ping me if we see >5% deviation.

ops-oncall: Approved. I'll coordinate the rehearsal and postmortem if needed. Added minimal postmortem template to RN.

liz: Thanks all. Pin locked and quiet window scheduled. I'll post internal announce at 17:30 and pin this thread. Reopen if last-minute edits.

michael: :rocket:

samir: standing by.

ops-oncall: standby acknowledged.

liz: thread closed.
